title: Hacking on Autopilot: Inside ARTEX Cybercrime Campaigns
description: ARTEX is an AI-powered autonomous hacking platform used by cybercriminals to conduct large-scale, financially motivated attacks. It leverages AI agents to discover and exploit web vulnerabilities such as Remote Code Execution (RCE) and conduct supply chain attacks with minimal human interaction. The platform, originally open-source, has been forked and remains publicly accessible despite being closed by its developer. ARTEX operators primarily use Chinese AI models and deploy attacks broadly, targeting various industries including gray-market code-signing certificate shops. Misconfigurations expose many ARTEX instances publicly, enabling remote access to administrative interfaces and operator data.
